title: Flood Advisory issued November 16 at 7:59PM AST until November 16 at 10:00PM AST by NWS San Juan PR
description: * WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected. * WHERE...Aguada County in Puerto Rico... Aguadilla County in Puerto Rico... Camuy County in Puerto Rico... Isabela County in Puerto Rico... Moca County in Puerto Rico... Quebradillas County in Puerto Rico... * WHEN...Until 1000 PM AST. * IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 758 PM AST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This will cause urban and small stream flooding. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. - Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
